name: The Province of Syntax
description: Master the fundamental building blocks of code.

dialogue.intro: The world's Source Code is breaking, child. Use WASD to move. Talk to the Queen next.
dialogue.progress: The Queen is waiting just north of here.

dialogue.locked: Speak to Pappa Heroka before approaching the throne.
dialogue.intro: Take this Code-Dex. A Thief has stolen our Royal Variables. Head North-East and bring them back!
dialogue.progress: The Thief was last seen near the North-East ruins.

dialogue.locked: You aren't worth my time yet. Get a Code-Dex first.
dialogue.intro: You want the Variables? You'll have to solve for 'X' first!
dialogue.win: Fine! Take the Identity Medal. You've got potential.
dialogue.lose: Ha! Your logic is as undefined as an uninitialized variable!

dialogue.locked: Only those who have captured the Thief may enter the King's Pass.
dialogue.intro: Let's see if your logic is greater than or equal to mine!
dialogue.win: Impressive. You've earned the Logic Medal.
dialogue.lose: Your math doesn't add up, traveler.

dialogue.locked: The Mountain King must vouch for you before you face my arrows.
dialogue.intro: Life is a series of choices. Pick the wrong one and you're out!
dialogue.win: Sharp eye. The Decision Medal is yours.
dialogue.lose: You missed the target. Try rethinking your branching logic.

dialogue.locked: The Archer's Ridge is your current path. Return when you have the Decision Medal.
dialogue.intro: Repeat after me: Iteration is the path to enlightenment.
dialogue.win: You have broken the loop. Take the Cycle Medal.
dialogue.lose: You are stuck in an infinite loop of failure!

dialogue.locked: A king only speaks to Masters. Collect all 4 medals of the province first.
dialogue.intro: You have the medals. I grant you the key to the Bottom-Left Castle. Prove yourself to the Mage.
dialogue.progress: The Mage awaits you in the Castle center.

dialogue.locked: The Castle gates remain shut to you.
dialogue.intro: I am the Master of Syntax. Can you weave Variables, Loops, and Logic into one?
dialogue.win: Unbelievable! You have mastered the Province of Syntax. Map 2 awaits!
dialogue.lose: Magic requires precision. Your code is too messy!
